Amiable

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amiable"** means having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner. (मिलनसार)

 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her **amiable** personality and always makes everyone feel welcome.
 
 
 
• **"Unfriendly" **refers to someone who is not friendly, kind, or pleasant. (अमित्र)
 
 
• **Example: **His **unfriendly** attitude made it difficult for him to make new friends.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amiable'** is **'unfriendly'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restless **(बेचैन): Unable to rest or relax due to anxiety or boredom.

 
 
• **Example:** The** restless** child couldn't sit still during the long meeting.
 
 
 
• **Sad **(दुखी): Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt **sad **after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Joyful** (आनंदित): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** The** joyful **reunion brought tears to their eyes.
